unresolvedConflicts.subject: InfraVia Capital Partners manager-governance status
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The authoritative repository snapshot sets knownManager to false and canonicalManager to null, while the separately supplied manager-universe list includes InfraVia Capital Partners. Under the explicit knownManager=false scope rule, the manager must be returned as OUT_OF_SCOPE_UNKNOWN_MANAGER, with no proposed manager addition and no proposed fund records.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: A repository-governance owner should reconcile the FUND_MANIFEST manager registry with the supplied manager-universe list. After InfraVia Capital Partners is formally added to the canonical manager manifest, rerun the fund census under the resulting known-manager snapshot.

notes: The supplied FUND_MANIFEST snapshot and manager-universe data were reviewed.
The snapshot contains no repository fund rows, so there are no matchedRepoFunds or repoOnlyRecords to reconcile.
Fund-level inclusion research and vehicle proposals are contractually inapplicable because the governing snapshot sets knownManager to false.
No evidence URLs were invented or inferred.
